title: Chapter 411 Natural And Man-Made Disasters
content:
Chapter 411 Natural And Man-Made Disasters

Wang Shuo made up his mind and took out a thunder bomb.

Mixed in his own attack.

"Bang."

A loud noise directly startled the people around, and they all looked sideways.

Wu Jie flew backwards, blood spurted out of his mouth, dyeing the snow red.

Take advantage of your illness to kill you!

Since the opponent's defense has been broken, Wang Shuo stepped forward, stabbed with his spear, and with a move of "Dragon Out of the Sea", the spear penetrated Wu Jie's chest, and the surging internal force exploded in his body.

A big hole was blown in his chest, and he died on the spot.

Seeing this, Chen Chen, who was fighting with Zhu Dongheng, withdrew from the battlefield without hesitation.

Fleeing far away.

Zhu Dongheng wanted to chase, but his speed was not as fast as the opponent, and the opponent escaped.

Next, everyone worked together to kill the snow monster and obtained two sixth-level magic cores.

There are many precious materials on the two bosses, such as teeth, bones, etc.

Wang Shuo and the others dismembered the bodies and collected the materials from them.

This trip can be said to be fruitful.

Wang Shuo also got an epic sword from Wu Jie and gave it to Lin Dabiao to use.

In the following days, they seemed to have used up all their luck and never encountered a general-level boss again, but they did find a lot of precious materials.

Wang Shuo still needed a few materials to build the Shura suit, but he had been searching for so long and still couldn't find it. Wang Shuo was no longer obsessed with it. Maybe he could go to the Ice and Snow City to see if he could exchange it.

They planned to go back.

Just at this time, an avalanche occurred.

They had already gone deep into the Great Snow Mountain. If there were generals who had entered the Great Snow Mountain many times, they would definitely know that this place could not be stayed for long.

Originally, this place was the territory of a star-level boss. Wang Shuo and his team were lucky and were not discovered by the other party, otherwise they would definitely be dead.

The towering giant peak, with snow mixed with ice, poured down from above, like the Milky Way in the sky.

Wang Shuo looked up and was stunned!

This is... a natural disaster!

A person seems so insignificant in the face of such a disaster.

In fact, this is not a natural disaster, but a man-made disaster!

Someone is challenging the Star-level boss Ice Phoenix.

There is no place to hide nearby.

Everyone had to rely on Gong Zheng's shield to defend against the first wave of impact.

But the avalanche directly took away the land they were standing on.

Everyone was immediately scattered.

Fortunately, their physique was strong enough, otherwise the impact of the first wave of ice blocks would have killed them.

The next step was to be wrapped in ice and snow, and everyone slid down the mountain.

If they were lucky enough and were not buried alive, there was still a possibility of survival, after all, they all carried the water of life!

After an unknown period of time, Wang Shuo woke up in an ice crack.

At this time, he had many abrasions all over his body, his calf was pierced by an icicle, and his entire leg was frozen stiff and frozen together with the icicle.

Wang Shuo's upper body could still move, but after a slight movement, he felt a sharp pain in his thigh.

Wang Shuo endured the pain and took a drop of water of life.

It was as if a warm current flowed through his body, and his frozen calves slowly regained consciousness.

The injury was slowly recovering.

Wang Shuo was relieved. The water of life was indeed powerful.

He looked up and saw that the ice crack was hundreds of meters high.

Wang Shuo sighed. It seemed that it would be difficult to return to the ground.

At this time, he had no teammates around him, and he didn't know how they were doing.

When his calves could barely walk, Wang Shuo began to explore along the crack.

He didn't know if he could find a way out.
